statement: ∀ n : ℕ, 4≤n → Even n → (n:ℝ)<Real.exp (Real.exp 5) → ∃ p : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ 2≤n-p ∧ (n-p).primeFactorsList.length≤33 ∧ ((n:ℝ)<Real.exp (Real.exp (19/5)) → (n-p).primeFactorsList.length≤10)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 小偶数覆盖第三批 · FR-9006 · 把两个原型的素因子数界分别降至 10 和 33
plain_statement.en: New route · Finite-range coverage III · FR-9006 · Reduce the two prototype factor bounds to ten and thirty-three

brief.zh: 在轮筛起点以上用 FR-9003、9004 得 79 粗余项，再用 FR-7005 按重数计数。较小偶数用 FR-7006 和九个素数对。用同一个候选同时满足两条因子数界。
brief.en: Apply FR-9003 and FR-9004 above the wheel threshold and then FR-7005 to count factors with multiplicity. Use FR-7006 and nine prime pairs for smaller even inputs. The same prime must satisfy both factor bounds.
